actions.name: create-country-targeting-rule
actions.description: Set geographic targeting rules for a link with specific destination per country.

actions.name: create-short-link
actions.description: Create a new short link with optional parameters (title, UTM tags, expiration, cloaking, etc.)

actions.name: delete-short-link
actions.description: Permanently delete a short link by its unique link ID.

actions.name: expire-short-link
actions.description: Set an expiration date or click limit to deactivate a short link.

actions.name: get-domain-statistics
actions.description: Retrieve usage stats (clicks, conversions) for a domain within a time period.

actions.name: get-short-link-info-by-path
actions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a short link using its domain and path.

actions.name: get-link-clicks
actions.description: Retrieve click statistics for specific short links by their IDs.

actions.name: list-short-links
actions.description: Retrieve one page of links on a domain, with pagination and date-range filters.

actions.name: update-short-link
actions.description: Update an existing short link's original URL, path, title, or other properties using its link ID.

actions.name: list_domains
actions.description: List every domain on the Short.io account.

actions.name: get_domain
actions.description: Get the settings of one Short.io domain.

actions.name: get_link
actions.description: Get a short link and its settings by link ID.

actions.name: find_links_by_original_url
actions.description: Find every short link on a domain that points to a given long URL.

actions.name: create_links_bulk
actions.description: Create up to 1,000 short links on one domain in a single request.

actions.name: archive_link
actions.description: Archive a short link (hide it from the dashboard; the short URL keeps redirecting).

actions.name: unarchive_link
actions.description: Restore an archived short link to the active list.

actions.name: add_tag_to_links
actions.description: Append one tag to one or more short links.

actions.name: generate_qr_code
actions.description: Generate a QR code image (PNG or SVG) for a short link.

actions.name: list_folders
actions.description: List the link folders on a domain.

actions.name: create_folder
actions.description: Create a link folder on a domain.

actions.name: list_country_rules
actions.description: List the country redirect rules of a short link.

actions.name: delete_country_rule
actions.description: Remove the country redirect rule for one country from a short link.

actions.name: list_recent_clicks
actions.description: List the latest raw clicks on a domain (time, path, country, referrer, browser). Includes visitor IP and user agent.

actions.name: get_top_links
actions.description: Get the most-clicked link paths on a domain for a period.

actions.name: duplicate_link
actions.description: Create a copy of a short link with the same destination and settings.

actions.name: get_folder
actions.description: Get a link folder by its ID.

actions.name: get_link_open_graph
actions.description: Get the custom social-preview (OpenGraph) title, description and image set on a short link.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_link_created
triggers.description: Fires when a new short link is created on a domain. Useful to sync newly created links to other systems.
